column1: # We start permissive (IGNORE the noisy, low-value baseline rules a static SPA
# always triggers) so the scan blocks only on findings that matter. Tighten
# (change IGNORE -> FAIL) as the app is hardened.
# CSP is set by nginx (docker/nginx.conf). Baseline flags "unsafe-inline" in
# style-src, which Angular's runtime styles require; reviewed and accepted.
